projects.description_en: SqueekSwap allows holders to trade Squeek Genesis NFTs directly with one another. You select specific Genesis IDs to exchange, and both sides change hands in a single atomic transaction. Completed swaps earn Seeds, with double rewards if Squeektoshi is on his wheel.
projects.name: SqueekSwap

projects.description_en: A community boss raid powered by Squeektoshi's real wheel work on Squeekchain. Join free with a wallet signature, pick a role, cheer, and climb the season leaderboard.
projects.name: Squeek Boss Raid

projects.description_en: Squeek Deep is a single-player pixel-art mining roguelite where you control Pip, a hamster digging through six earth layers. The game is powered by a real Squeekchain wheel that moves the basket, or an offline simulation in practice mode. Collect gems to fill Pip's cheeks and bring the treasure back to the surface.
projects.name: Squeek Deep

projects.description_en: Squeek Supply Station is a three-minute merge game that uses real Squeekchain settlements to drive daily hamster supply runs. Players compete on a server-verified leaderboard where scores are pinned on Sepolia.
projects.name: Squeek Supply Station

projects.description_en: Mint a free ERC-721 hamster on Sepolia whose mood and artwork reflect the real Squeekchain wheel. The hamster zooms when the wheel spins and sleeps when it stops. The project includes a React mint site with original SVG artwork and previews of different energy states.
projects.name: Squeek Companion

projects.description_en: A free Squeekchain arcade powered by a real hamster. You aim a collector around the wheel to catch gold seeds and dodge blue glitches as the pace increases. The game features live boost events and a shared leaderboard.
projects.name: Wheelkeepers

projects.description_en: Squeek Pal is a free browser extension that places a tiny pixel hamster on x.com. The hamster runs in sync with Squeektoshi's real wheel on Squeekchain. Users can play a demo or install the extension for Chrome and Firefox.
projects.name: Squeek Pal

projects.description_en: A weekly community boss raid where real wheel work deals damage to the target. Players sign a daily attack to build a streak and earn their place among the slayers. The project centers on a single hamster powering a shared community challenge.
projects.name: Wheel Raid

projects.description_en: A 60-second arcade game where players navigate a maze to collect Squeeks and avoid hazards. The layout is determined by official Squeekchain data and the real hamster wheel, ensuring every player faces the same challenge in a given round. It supports keyboard, touch, and swipe controls.
projects.name: Squeek Maze Sprint

projects.description_en: An independent community dashboard for Squeekchain. It tracks live block height, real-world work, SQK supply, and recent settlements.
projects.name: Squeekchain • Network dashboard

paragraphs.text: Squeek Runner is a pixel-art hamster arcade game built with React, TypeScript, and Phaser 3. As described on
the project website
, you tap to run, hold to charge, and release near a bright band for a clean flip. Five consecutive landings trigger ten seconds of Fever mode.
To understand the mechanics, start with
the project website
for the core gameplay loop. You can also explore
a public source
and
a public source
to see how the technical stack supports the visual style and interaction design.

projects.description_en: Squeek Runner is a browser-based pixel-art arcade game where you tap to run, hold to charge, and release to flip a hamster. The goal is to land flips cleanly, with five consecutive successes triggering a Fever mode. It is free to play and includes optional Squeekchain testnet reads.
projects.name: Squeek Runner

projects.description_en: Squeek Pet is a browser-based virtual pet game where a pixel hamster mirrors the movements of Squeektoshi, the real hamster powering Squeekchain. You watch your digital companion run and nap in sync with the physical wheel, creating a direct link between the toy chain and its biological engine.
projects.name: Squeek Pet

projects.description_en: VeilHub is a rental marketplace for Squeek NFTs on Sepolia. Users can list their NFTs for temporary usage or rent access rights from other holders. Payments are settled in SQK, with the NFT held in contract escrow until the rental period expires.
projects.name: VeilHub

projects.description_en: An early ecosystem signal. Its purpose and affiliation still need confirmation.
projects.name: squeek.fun

projects.description_en: Squeek Market is a marketplace for exploring and trading Squeekchain NFTs on Sepolia. Users can browse the collection and inspect live attributes like power, rewards, level, and cooldown that travel with each token. The platform allows users to list items and view on-chain data for these digital companions.
projects.name: Squeek Market

projects.description_en: Turn your Squeek into profile pictures, banners, wallpapers, stickers and share cards. Free, read-only, and made in your browser.
projects.name: Squeek Studio

projects.description_en: A transparent browser source that adds Squeektoshi, the Squeekchain hamster, to your live stream. It displays animated stats, block progress, and queued alerts for events like new blocks or session records. Configure the layout, theme, and sound to fit your OBS or Streamlabs setup.
projects.name: Squeektoshi Stream Overlay

projects.description_en: Squeek Appraiser is a read-only tool for comparing up to three Squeeks on Squeekchain. It evaluates power, asking price, staking share, and merge potential to help buyers make informed decisions. The tool calculates a score based on power relative to price and merge compatibility.
projects.name: Squeek Appraiser

projects.description_en: Keep the Lights On is a betting game where players wager test SQK on how many numbered bulbs Squeektoshi's wheel will power before he falls asleep. Every ten minutes of continuous running lights the next bulb, and the pot is shared among lit bulbs, with higher numbers and earlier bets receiving larger slices.
projects.name: Keep the Lights On

projects.description_en: A playable pixel village where a real hamster's wheel activity controls the weather and world events. You plant crops, care for villagers and pray to Squeektoshi, whose live movements determine when the sun rises and how your civilization develops.
projects.name: SQUEEK GOD

projects.description_en: Squeek Odometer tracks the distance Squeektoshi runs on its wheel in real time. You can view live speed and RPM, check the nightly distance log, and make a guess for how far the hamster will run tonight. The site also allows you to perform a zero-value check-in on the Sepolia testnet.
projects.name: Squeek Odometer

paragraphs.text: Squeek Boss Raid is a weekly co-op event on Squeekchain where the boss's health decreases only when Squeektoshi the hamster runs. This damage comes from his certified wheel work on SqueekCore, as described in
the project website
To follow the details, you can check
a public source
for more context. It helps to see how enlisting with a class and planning round calls fit into the on-chain leaderboard experience.

projects.description_en: A weekly cooperative raid where a boss's health decreases only when Squeektoshi the hamster runs on his wheel. Players enlist with a class, predict the hamster's activity in ten-minute rounds, and compete for points on an on-chain leaderboard.
projects.name: Squeek Boss Raid

projects.description_en: WheelPad issues memecoins on SqueekChain where the supply unlocks only as Squeektoshi runs on the wheel. Users can obtain free test tokens on the Sepolia testnet to interact with the project.
projects.name: WheelPad

projects.description_en: Squeek Keeper is a Chrome extension that monitors your Squeekchain wallet in the background. It alerts you when Squeeks are ready to merge, when SQK is claimable, and when Squeektoshi starts running. You can also claim rewards directly from the extension without connecting or signing transactions.
projects.name: Squeek Keeper

projects.description_en: A read-only dashboard that displays the live state of the hamster-powered Squeekchain on Sepolia. It refreshes every 15 seconds to show block height, progress, settled round, difficulty, and pause status.
projects.name: Squeekchain Live Dashboard

projects.description_en: SqueekPulse is a live telemetry console and OBS stream overlay for Squeekchain. It displays settled blocks, SQK mints, supply, hamster wheel distance, and on-chain events in eight languages. The tool provides a transparent background overlay for streaming and a detailed dashboard for tracking chain activity.
projects.name: SqueekPulse

projects.description_en: PolyHamster is a prediction market where you bet play-seeds on how far, how long, and how hard Squeekchain's hamster runs tonight. Every market resolves automatically using data from the public Squeekchain API.
projects.name: PolyHamster

projects.description_en: Squeek Life is an unofficial fan game, NFT collection, and community token centered on Squeektoshi, the hamster who mines Squeekchain. Players vote on the art for a 1,111-item collection and earn whitelist spots by completing in-game missions. The project is currently in design with nothing deployed.
projects.name: SQK LIFE

projects.description_en: Squeek Tx Lab is a Sepolia-only workbench for Squeekchain. Connect a wallet to send SQK, manage approvals, play onchain games, and launch a fixed-supply token.
projects.name: Squeek Tx Lab

projects.description_en: Squeek Switchyard is a browser puzzle where you route five wagons of real Sepolia settlement blocks into three tunnels. The goal is to minimize the total overflow of blocks that exceed each tunnel's capacity. You can play against a one-minute clock for fun, though the timer does not affect your final score.
projects.name: Squeek Switchyard

projects.description_en: Squeek Raid is a browser-based game where you build a squad of on-chain Squeeks to fight three dungeon bosses. Your combat power is boosted by the live activity of a real hamster on a wheel, adding a physical element to the digital raid. The project also includes a terminal for exploring Sepolia transactions.
projects.name: Squeek Raid

projects.description_en: Squeek Arena is a 35-second rhythm game where you time boosts to build a combo and chase a personal best. Your score is powered by Squeektoshi's settled Squeekchain activity, blending your timing with the hamster's real wheel work.
projects.name: Squeek Arena

projects.description_en: SqueekMatchEscrow is a peer-to-peer marketplace for Squeeks that helps holders of a single token find a merge partner. Users can plan merges and trade directly without paying market fees. The tool operates on the Sepolia testnet.
projects.name: SqueekMatchEscrow

projects.description_en: A read-only Telegram bot that monitors Squeekchain wallets to alert users about claimable SQK, merge cooldowns, and hamster wheel activity. It provides a merge ladder for planning token upgrades and tracks wallet transfers, stakes, and block completions without requiring private keys.
projects.name: Squeek Holder Bot

paragraphs.text: Pixel Pit is a multiplayer game where each wallet holds a brush budget of zero to forty pixels. This budget refills only through settled Squeek blocks, and the contract rejects any paints that exceed this limit
the project website

To follow the source trail, start with the project website for the core mechanics. You can then cross-reference the details in the other public sources to see how the budget rules are described elsewhere
a public source

projects.description_en: Pixel Pit: a multiplayer game where each wallet has a brush budget of 0-40 pixels refilled only by settled Squeek blocks; the contract rejects paints beyond budget. Unofficial fan project on the Sepolia testnet.
projects.name: Pixel Pit

projects.description_en: A cooperative boss fight where the Squeekchain hamster's running distance directly reduces enemy health. Players add damage by pressing space to squeak, building combos for extra hits. The boss recovers when the hamster naps, requiring players to keep the wheel turning.
projects.name: Hamster Boss Raid

projects.description_en: Squeek Shift is a 75-second platformer where the live Squeekchain wheel determines whether the game takes place in a fast day lab or a low-gravity dream. Players jump over spikes and collect gold coins to build a score combo while the game speeds up through five levels. A practice mode allows offline play with simulated wheel data.
projects.name: Squeek Shift

projects.description_en: A farming and defense game where players grow six crops and trade their harvest. The core challenge involves protecting the farm from Brutus, a hamster antagonist. It offers a cozy gameplay loop focused on expansion and survival.
projects.name: Squeek Farm: Hamster Wars

projects.description_en: Squeek Survival is a guest-first prediction game where you duel Robo-Squeek by betting on virtual race distances. You pick Over or Under the robot's call, manage lives and boosters, and raid a local weekly boss. Each race generates printable art, and the game runs without token rewards.
projects.name: Squeek Survival

projects.description_en: HAMLOCK is a testnet toy where users lock ETH while a hamster runs on a wheel. The project is a simple experiment with no real value, offering a playful interaction with the Squeekchain ecosystem.
projects.name: HAMLOCK

projects.description_en: A free live samurai stream overlay and just-for-fun game powered by a hamster's wheel. Built on Squeekchain · community project, not an official Squeekchain site
projects.name: Rels on the Wheel

projects.description_en: Squeek Wars is a strategy game where you found a hamster village, grow fields, and train troops to raid other camps. The SEED token is generated by the real work of Squeekchain's hamster. The game is free to play on the Sepolia testnet.
projects.name: Squeek Wars

projects.description_en: A dashboard for Squeekchain that displays live network metrics, staking yields, and NFT levels. It includes a simulator to preview the results of fusing two Squeek NFTs to increase their power limits.
projects.name: SqueekLeveler & WheelPulse Studio

projects.description_en: Squeek Streak is a browser-based toolkit that connects your personal Telegram bot to the Squeekchain hamster wheel. You configure the bot to send alerts for specific events like wake-ups, sleep, rounds, and RPM changes. The tool runs entirely in your browser without requiring a backend or account.
projects.name: Squeek Streak

projects.description_en: A free three-lane rhythm game where you catch seeds on a gold line using keyboard or touch inputs. The game's speed and seed density are driven by the real-time RPM of a hamster wheel on Squeekchain, or by replaying its activity from the last 24 hours. You can play live when the hamster is running or switch to a calm practice track during quiet periods.
projects.name: Wheel Rhythm

paragraphs.text: Intelligent Dance Market is a Uniswap v4 hook where on-chain state acts as a 16-step drum machine, turning every trade into a note
the project website
. This design frames market activity as a rhythmic sequence rather than a standard ledger entry. To understand how this works, you can follow the technical details in
the documentation
or check
a team post
for context on the concept.

projects.description_en: Intelligent Dance Market is a Uniswap v4 hook that stores a 16-step drum machine in on-chain state. Every trade in the IDM/ETH pool flips a step, adjusts the bass line, and changes the tempo. The project turns market activity into a live, evolving musical sequence without any off-chain components.
projects.name: Intelligent Dance Market

projects.description_en: Turing Wheel is a Squeekchain project where a hamster's wheel acts as a computer clock. You write a one-line program and queue it on Sepolia to watch the hamster execute it. Each pass of the wheel counts as one clock cycle.
projects.name: Turing Wheel

projects.description_en: Burrow Raid is a 3D hamster boss battle where you defend the burrow against the Cable Gnawer. Choose a Fighter, Guardian, or Medic role to play solo practice or join a co-op room with other players.
projects.name: Burrow Raid

projects.description_en: Wheelwatch is a community dashboard that displays live data from Squeekchain. It tracks the current block height, work, wheel distance, SQK supply, and recent settlements. This project offers a public window into the hamster-powered chain's activity.
projects.name: Wheelwatch

projects.description_en: HamsterRun is a pixel-art game on Sepolia where you mint a free HAM and book six rounds of training. You can then race against other players and invite friends to join your crew. The project is an independent testnet demo with no official Squeek mining rights or transferable points.
projects.name: HamsterRun

projects.description_en: A wallet-connected companion for Squeekchain on Sepolia that lets you run checkpoints, deposit Squeeks, claim rewards, and stake SQK. It operates as a single-page static site without requiring a backend or API keys.
projects.name: Squeek Keeper Console

projects.description_en: Wheelbound turns Squeektoshi's real running into a daily narrative where every settled Squeekchain round advances the story. You pick a tactic card each day to influence damage against a weekly boss, tracking progress through landmarks and a live stream overlay.
projects.name: Wheelbound

projects.description_en: Squeek is a browser-based arcade game where players manage a hamster's night shift by planning routes and delivering cargo. Gameplay mechanics change dynamically based on the real-time activity of a hamster on a wheel, such as speed and rest periods. The project focuses on local score tracking and route optimization without involving tokens or betting.
projects.name: Squeek

projects.description_en: Squeek Beat: Hamster Tour is a free, two-lane rhythm arcade game for the Squeekchain community. Players complete a 60-second hamster tour across three acts, collecting sunflowers to find their groove. The game features original hamster-in-wheel artwork and tracks local personal bests.
projects.name: Squeek Beat: Hamster Tour

projects.description_en: Squeek Price Action Terminal converts Squeekchain's live hamster wheel activity into price-action candlesticks. You read the wheel data to spot signals and predict the next round using virtual SQK. The project frames the hamster's movements as a market to challenge an AI in a prediction game.
projects.name: Squeek Price Action Terminal

projects.description_en: Race or bet against Squeektoshi, a real hamster on a live wheel. Every outcome settles on the real round from Squeekchain's public API.
projects.name: Squeek Wheel Arena

projects.description_en: Squeekstr Desk is an interactive paper protocol simulation for Squeekchain. Users can deposit Squeeks, merge power, earn paper SQK, and trade tracker receipts without a wallet. It serves as a community project for the Squeekchain Buildooooor badge.
projects.name: Squeekstr Desk

projects.description_en: Squeek Race visualizes Squeekchain's on-chain computational power as a live hamster race. It displays block progress, cumulative work, and a 24-hour leaderboard that updates every 10 seconds. The runners are fictional, with work distributed randomly among five hamsters to create shifting rankings.
projects.name: Squeek Race

paragraphs.text: Squeek Run is a silly browser runner featuring a hamster with terrible fashion sense. According to
the project website
, you put a pressure cooker on its head, hand it a toilet plunger, and try to survive the wheel.
To understand the details, you can follow the trail in
a public source
and
a public source
. These entries provide the context for the game's unique mechanics and the hamster's questionable style choices.

projects.description_en: Squeek Run is a browser-based runner where you dress a hamster in absurd accessories and dodge obstacles. You collect seeds and chase a high score in a game powered by Squeekchain activity.
projects.name: Squeek Run

projects.description_en: A live dashboard that answers whether Squeektoshi is currently running on the wheel. It displays real-time telemetry like RPM and total work, alongside Squeekchain stats such as block height and difficulty. The interface also links to the official livestream and offers an optional button to send a harmless transaction to the SQK token.
projects.name: Squeektoshi Live

projects.description_en: Wheel Run is an endless survival race game driven by the live Squeekchain hamster wheel. Players compete in a race where the hamster's speed determines the pace, creating a unique interactive experience.
projects.name: Wheel Run

projects.description_en: WheelOps is an interactive arcade game and NFT merge lab that uses live telemetry from Squeektoshi's physical wheel. Players control a hamster runner where real RPM data affects speed and obstacles, while a forge simulates merging NFTs to increase power levels.
projects.name: WheelOps

projects.description_en: A real-time block explorer and cryptographic verifier for Squeekchain. It displays live hardware telemetry and adaptive difficulty data while verifying EIP-1967 proxy contracts on Ethereum Sepolia.
projects.name: Squeekchain Explorer

projects.description_en: Squeek Out is a game of nerve on Squeekchain where players ride Squeektoshi's wheel and must bail before he stops. You join a lobby, stay on the wheel as long as you dare, and claim a share of the game treasury if you exit in time. The game ends when the hamster stops, and anyone still on the wheel is caught and loses their entry.
projects.name: Squeek Out

projects.description_en: Squeek Mode is an AI chat interface that uses your own OpenRouter key to provide reliable responses with occasional creative detours. You can follow the hamster's influence and inspect every Squeekchain source receipt to verify the data behind the interactions.
projects.name: Squeek Mode

projects.description_en: Squeek or Sleep is a free prediction game where you guess whether Squeektoshi naps, jogs, or gets the zoomies in each 10-minute round. Results are read directly from SqueekCore on Sepolia, with rarer outcomes earning more points. Weekly seasons and a leaderboard track performance based on how often specific behaviors occur.
projects.name: Squeek or Sleep

paragraphs.text: Wheelhaven is an original crop strategy game where players grow carrots, broccoli, and sunflower seeds powered by real hamster wheel passages, as described in the project overview
the project website
To understand how this works, you can explore the details provided in the public materials
a public source
. This helps you see the connection between the physical wheel movements and the in-game growth mechanics.

projects.description_en: Wheelhaven is an original crop strategy game where players grow carrots, broccoli, and sunflower seeds powered by real hamster wheel passages.
projects.name: Wheelhaven

projects.description_en: Squeekchain is a blockchain where a real hamster running on a wheel generates work that settles to Ethereum. Sensors record the movement to produce Squeek blocks and issue SQK tokens. The project connects physical hamster activity to on-chain records.
projects.name: Squeekchain

projects.description_en: Wheel Odds is a prediction market where you bet on the work output of the Squeekchain hamster wheel. Every 10 minutes, SqueekCore settles the round onchain, and you win if the certified work lands over or under your chosen line. The system uses no oracles or admins, relying entirely on the immutable ledger for payouts.
projects.name: Wheel Odds

projects.description_en: SqueekRun: Crystal Caverns is a free browser platformer where you control a hamster running through an endless cave. You collect crystals to upgrade a mining colony that generates simulated SQK. The game also triggers bonus events based on Squeekchain testnet block milestones.
projects.name: SqueekRun: Crystal Caverns

projects.description_en: A cozy 2D platformer where you guide a tiny hamster on a big adventure. The game focuses on a relaxed experience centered around the hamster's journey.
projects.name: Hamster Tales: The Great Seed Adventure

projects.description_en: A read-only tracker that measures how long SqueekCore takes to settle closed rounds on Sepolia. It displays batches, gaps, and unsettled rounds at a finalized block, with options for alerts and CSV downloads.
projects.name: Squeekchain settlement latency

projects.description_en: Squeek Wheel Runner is a pixel hamster game where the character's speed is driven by the real-time rotation of a physical hamster wheel on Squeekchain. Players jump over obstacles using keyboard or touch controls, with the pace determined by live on-chain data. The project also provides a transparent overlay for streaming the live wheel speed and block progress.
projects.name: Squeek Wheel Runner

projects.description_en: Squeek Burrow Circuit is a turn-based puzzle game where you rotate underground tunnels to guide a hamster home. You navigate through twelve original levels that introduce mechanics like junctions, switches, and gates. The game features a cozy aesthetic and a direct connection to the Squeekchain community.
projects.name: Squeek Burrow Circuit

projects.description_en: Hamster Derby is a prediction game where users bet on simulated hamster-wheel races. You stake funds on one of four hamsters, and the winners split the entire pot held in an unowned smart contract. The race outcome is determined by a seed block hash, ensuring no one can predict the result before betting closes.
projects.name: Hamster Derby

projects.description_en: SqueekDash is an arcade game where you steer Squeektoshi down a shavings track to collect sunflower seeds while dodging obstacles. The game speed increases automatically as your score rises, and the interface displays live Squeekchain block data and wheel speed metrics.
projects.name: SqueekDash

projects.description_en: Pip is a 3D hamster companion that lives in your browser. You can pet, feed and play with it, chat using on-device AI, and watch read-only Squeekchain events. The project is available in English and Traditional Chinese.
projects.name: Pip

projects.description_en: Squeekcrumb is a token experiment on Squeekchain where a hamster running on a wheel powers the system. The internet earns crumbs as the hamster works.
projects.name: Squeekcrumb

projects.description_en: Independent analytics for the Squeekchain ecosystem: live network status, hamster wheel telemetry, Squeek blocks, SQK token economy, events, mining activity and wallet lookup.
projects.name: Squeekpulse U1

projects.description_en: Nap or Sprint? is a prediction arcade where you guess the outcome of Squeekchain rounds based on a real hamster's activity. You can duel friends and collect digital art generated from the hamster's wheel movements.
projects.name: Nap or Sprint?

projects.description_en: SqueekPack: Jetstream Run is a retro arcade game where a hamster with a steam jetpack runs through an endless copper mine. The gameplay is driven by real wheel telemetry from Squeektoshi, adding a physical element to the digital chaos. Players boost through the mine, collect coins and Golden Nuts, and sign high scores with an EVM wallet.
projects.name: SqueekPack: Jetstream Run

projects.description_en: Squeekville is an illustrated hamster town where verified Squeekchain work powers local amenities like ovens and fountains. You act as the mayor, choosing where to send energy to trigger neighborhood events. The project turns proof-of-work activity into a visual simulation of a small community.
projects.name: Squeekville

projects.description_en: Look up public Genesis progress, explore the official badge checklist, and understand unofficial aura estimates. An independent Squeekchain community tool.
projects.name: Aura Board

projects.description_en: Hamster Tower is a turn-based climb where each round of real work by the Squeekchain hamster creates a new floor. The round's data determines the floor type, enemies, map and weather, while long naps leave treasure chests.
projects.name: Hamster Tower

projects.description_en: Race Squeektoshi is a rhythm arcade game where you compete against a real hamster on Squeekchain. You chase recorded ghosts, manage your stamina, and predict the next wheel round. The game features one real hamster as your tiny rival.
projects.name: Race Squeektoshi

projects.description_en: Squeek Block NFT is a community project that mints SVG block data cards for SqueekChain on the Sepolia testnet. Users connect a wallet, select a specific block number from 1 to 10,000, and mint a card that displays that block's round, work, and rarity tier. The cards are generated on-chain, with early blocks designated as Legendary or Epic.
projects.name: Squeek Block NFT

projects.description_en: A 6x6 turn-based puzzle where you guide a hamster to rescue three pups and reach the nest. The live Squeekchain hamster determines whether wheel bridges or sleeping gates open, adding a dynamic element to the 12 burrow puzzles.
projects.name: Squeek Burrow Rescue

projects.description_en: Squeek Den is a browser-based game where players manage a hamster den and earn Watts by spinning a wheel. You spend these Watts in a shop to customize your burrow and participate in raids against other players. The game features a leaderboard and a certificate system that tracks your progress and speed records.
projects.name: Squeek Den

projects.description_en: A live dashboard for Squeekchain that displays real-time telemetry from the WHEELY9000 hamster wheel. It tracks wheel speed, distance, and progress toward the next Squeek block. Users can also view network analytics and Squeek portfolios.
projects.name: Squeekchain community dashboard

projects.description_en: SqueekFi is a community prediction market where you bet test points on Squeekchain milestones. You connect a wallet to create markets or join existing ones, tracking confirmed on-chain data. The platform uses non-transferable points, keeping the focus on prediction rather than financial wagering.
projects.name: SqueekFi

projects.description_en: Squeekchain Arcade offers free browser puzzle games with a Squeekchain twist. Players can play Number Slide on Sepolia, where a contract verifies every winning run. The game involves sliding tiles to beat the clock while ensuring your win is verified on the network.
projects.name: Squeekchain Arcade

projects.description_en: Squeek Hatchery is a local demo that uses real wheel data to incubate a virtual hamster. You aim a lamp and wait for 60 seconds of active wheel movement to save your hamster. NFT minting is not yet available.
projects.name: Squeek Hatchery

projects.description_en: Burrow Siege is a pixel-art tower defense game where a real hamster on a wheel powers your towers. You build defenses and charge them to survive 20 waves of enemies protecting a seed vault.
projects.name: Burrow Siege

projects.description_en: WheelCam provides transparent OBS browser-source overlays for Squeektoshi's wheel stream. You can add a corner bug, lower third, ticker, rpm gauge, run card, or alerts to your broadcast. The overlays are driven by live wheel data and are free to use.
projects.name: WheelCam

projects.description_en: Pick a stall. The real wheel decides how fast it works. A small, living night market for the Squeekchain community. Play as a guest, no Squeek required.
projects.name: Night Market

projects.description_en: QuadConnect is an automated vault on SqueekChain that deposits USDC, ETH, or SQK to participate in mining boards and long/short markets. Earnings from these activities compound automatically, allowing users to grow their balance without manual intervention. The project currently operates on a testnet using paper money.
projects.name: quadConnect

projects.description_en: Hamster Mining Reserve lets users pool their Squeekchain Squeeks to reach high mining levels that are individually unaffordable. This collective approach grants participants approximately double the mining power. The project is a collaboration between IMD and Squeekchain.
projects.name: Hamster Mining Reserve

projects.description_en: SqueekRaid is a co-op boss raid where a party of six fighters battles the Snooze King using the actual distance Squeektoshi runs each night. Players select tactic cards to determine their damage output, aiming to defeat the boss within seven nights. Victories can be recorded on the Sepolia testnet for on-chain verification.
projects.name: SqueekRaid

projects.description_en: A browser-based pixel-art adventure where you guide Chang the hamster through an autumn chestnut forest to find his missing friend Alice. The game features enemy combat, weapon swapping, and a shield mechanic, with progress saved locally on your device.
projects.name: Hamster Friendship: The Lost Alice

projects.description_en: Night Canvas turns Squeektoshi's nightly wheel activity into unique pixel artworks. You can watch the live canvas or explore the last 30 nights to see how the hamster's runs shape the visual output.
projects.name: Night Canvas

projects.description_en: Squeek Merge Preview is a non-custodial tool for rehearsing Squeek merges before signing. You select a survivor and a donor to compare outcomes at Day 0, +7 days, and +30 days, marking regret points. The site saves local snapshots for comparison and does not initiate any transactions.
projects.name: Squeek Merge Preview

projects.description_en: Exsqueektion is a solo extraction game where players loot a beautiful but dangerous garden. The goal is to collect items and escape before the hamster-powered portal collapses.
projects.name: Exsqueektion

projects.description_en: Wheel Raid is a cooperative browser game where one to four players fight the Chrome Gnawer boss. Players choose to attack, defend, or heal, with their moves powered by confirmed Squeekchain rounds. You can play archived raids or wait for live confirmed rounds to join a party.
projects.name: Wheel Raid

projects.description_en: An early ecosystem signal. Its purpose and affiliation still need confirmation.
projects.name: Squeekerant

projects.description_en: Squeek Signal Garden is a puzzle game where you route energy from a hamster wheel to grow four flower beacons. You play three progressively harder 6x6 boards within a shared three-minute clock, using rotation limits and connection streaks. The game serves as a stream companion, allowing you to share your restored night garden with an audience.
projects.name: Squeek Signal Garden

projects.description_en: SqueekSense is a dashboard that tracks Squeektoshi's live wheel activity on Squeekchain. It displays current speed, daily distance, and a heatmap of the hamster's 24-hour rhythm. The tool also uses historical data to forecast the probability of the next run.
projects.name: SqueekSense

projects.description_en: SqueekRaider is an idle cooperative game where players choose a stance to face an owl boss together. A real hamster powers the raid mechanics on the Sepolia test network. The game is free to play and has no prizes or payouts.
projects.name: SqueekRaider

projects.description_en: Wheel Archive turns settled batches of Squeekchain rounds into sealed capsules. You can explore the live archive and leave a zero-value stamp on Sepolia.
projects.name: Wheel Archive

projects.description_en: The Last Wheel is a frozen city simulation powered by Squeektoshi, a real hamster on Squeekchain. Each turn of the hamster's wheel generates heat to keep the town alive. You can explore the environment and verify the hamster's work through transactions written to Ethereum.
projects.name: The Last Wheel

paragraphs.text: Squeek Picks is a research initiative by the IdentityMD worker network. It organizes reports, supporting files, and provenance data into distinct groups based on specific jobs
the project website
To follow the source trail, start with the project website for an overview of the grouped outputs
the project website
. You can also explore the code repository to see how these research components are structured and maintained
the code repository

projects.description_en: Squeek Picks is a prediction game where you guess the nightly running distance, busiest hours, and block count of Squeektoshi, a real hamster on a wheel. Correct guesses earn points for a leaderboard, and accurate season predictions can result in a Sepolia NFT receipt.
projects.name: Squeek Picks

paragraphs.text: Squeek Burrow is a 3D hamster kart racing game for Squeekchain, built with React, Three.js, and Vite. As described in
the project website
, all models, textures, music, and sound effects are generated in code, meaning there are no asset files.
To understand how this works, you can explore the technical details in
a public source
or
a public source
. These materials help you follow the source trail and see how the code generates the game's visual and audio elements directly.

projects.description_en: Squeek Burrow is a 3D hamster kart racing game for Squeekchain. Your turbo charges twice as fast while the real Squeekchain hamster runs. All models, textures, music and sound effects are generated in code.
projects.name: Squeek Burrow

projects.description_en: Hamster Hour is a betting platform where users wager IMD on the outcome of a hamster running on a wheel. Participants watch a live camera feed and guess the jackpot amount during a one-hour session. The project operates on Ethereum and centers on the activity of a real hamster.
projects.name: Hamster Hour

projects.description_en: Squeektoshi live is a dashboard that displays real-time data from Squeekchain, including the hamster's wheel speed, distance traveled, and block progress. It refreshes every 15 seconds to show the current state of the network and SQK supply.
projects.name: Squeektoshi live

projects.description_en: COVER is a testnet application that provides fixed-payout cover for zero-work SqueekCore rounds. Users can read live pool data, quote policies in mSQK, and explore a static demo on Sepolia.
projects.name: COVER

projects.description_en: A browser game where you roll a virtual wheel for twenty seconds. Your distance is compared against Squeektoshi's real wheel counter. You can also try a practice run.
projects.name: Spoke Sprint

projects.description_en: SqueekStage is a live OBS overlay for Squeekchain and SQK tipping on Sepolia. It displays a wheel-o-meter, block progress, and on-chain tip alerts for your stream. The tool runs without a backend or custody, allowing you to share your setup from squeekstage.online.
projects.name: SqueekStage

projects.description_en: SqueekRace Arena is a free arcade game where you race against AI opponents using Squeektoshi's real-world wheel activity. You steer, dodge crates, and boost to finish the Squeek Grand Prix, with results verified by the server. The project combines simulated racing with live hardware data from the hamster's wheel.
projects.name: SqueekRace Arena

projects.description_en: A free prediction game on Squeekchain. Guess whether Squeektoshi the hamster is running or asleep next round, scored from live wheel telemetry.
projects.name: Squeek or Sleep

projects.description_en: Squeek Dashboard is a live explorer for Squeekchain that displays every Squeek's holder, level, power, and vault status. It ranks wallets by staked power, tracks merges and vault activity in real time, and allows users to look up specific addresses for their SQK rewards and activity history.
projects.name: Squeek Dashboard

projects.description_en: Squeek Pet is a tiny pixel hamster that runs when Squeektoshi runs. You can pat, feed and wake the hamster while it reads Squeekchain data. The project is a read-only tool that does not require a wallet.
projects.name: Squeek Pet

projects.description_en: Squeek Wake & Raid displays live telemetry from the WHEELY9000 hamster wheel on Squeekchain. It features a wake siren that triggers on wheel motion, a 6-pocket raid mini-game for collecting relics, and a keeper console for sending Sepolia transactions.
projects.name: Squeek Wake & Raid

projects.description_en: Squeek Spin Art turns the mining wheel of Squeektoshi, the hamster that powers Squeekchain, into a live painting tool. You can watch the card fill with paint in real time based on the hamster's speed, replay previous nights, or add the live feed to your own stream. The project also generates unique spin-art portraits for Squeek NFTs.
projects.name: Squeek Spin Art

projects.description_en: SQUEEK KINGDOM is a free, playable pixel-art strategy game where you build a hamster kingdom and explore the wilds. The gameplay incorporates real SqueekChain activity, allowing players to race with the hamster and survive various rounds.
projects.name: SQUEEK KINGDOM

projects.description_en: Hamster Rush is a 32-bit pixel auto-shooter where players control a hamster to defeat bosses and collect seeds. The game runs on Squeekchain and Sepolia.
projects.name: Hamster Rush

projects.description_en: Squeek Garden is a virtual garden where hamster snacks grow based on the activity of Squeektoshi, the real hamster powering Squeekchain. You harvest different types of snacks depending on whether the hamster is running, resting, or just finished a session. A shared pantry system unlocks new seeds for the community as it fills up, and you can visit neighbors to water their plants.
projects.name: Squeek Garden

projects.description_en: Squeek Radar is a public live monitor for the Squeekchain hamster wheel: activity, events, milestones, rounds, blocks and settlements. No wallet needed.
projects.name: Squeek Radar: Live Activity and Event Monitor

projects.description_en: Squeekscope provides a daily hamster tarot reading for any Ethereum address based on Squeektoshi's settled wheel work. Users can read their card, compare a pair, and trace every draw. The tool is a static, browser-only application that generates a unique reading for each address and day.
projects.name: Squeekscope

projects.description_en: Squeek Peek is a live dashboard that tracks Squeekchain blocks, settled rounds, and wheel work on Ethereum Sepolia. It reads data directly from SqueekCore to provide a real-time view of Squeektoshi's activity. The tool serves as a simple companion for monitoring the hamster-powered chain.
projects.name: Squeek Peek

projects.description_en: Squeek Radar is a dashboard for exploring Squeekchain, a hamster-powered toychain on Ethereum. It features an interactive pixel hamster wheel, a local work simulation, and a view of recent Sepolia activity. Users can give a seed, watch the wheel, and follow the work to see the chain in action.
projects.name: Squeek Radar

projects.description_en: Squeek Boss Raid is a community boss fight where the real Squeekchain hamster's wheel drains the boss's health in real time. Players connect a wallet to add their own on-chain hits to the shared damage total.
projects.name: Squeek Boss Raid

projects.description_en: SqueekPet is a pixel-art hamster game where you adopt a companion, decorate their home, and run a woodland trail. The game connects to Squeektoshi's real wheel activity, which can trigger in-game events like breezes and timestamped memories.
projects.name: SqueekPet

projects.description_en: Squeek Pulse is an independent, read-only analytics dashboard for SqueekChain. It tracks wheel activity, settled blocks, SQK issuance, and Squeek ownership on the Sepolia network.
projects.name: Squeek Pulse

projects.description_en: SQUEEK PENALTY is a fast, animated 1v1 penalty shootout game featuring competitive hamsters. Players pick a direction and kick to race to three goals, with the option to practice against an AI first. The game is designed to be completed in under two minutes.
projects.name: SQUEEK PENALTY

projects.description_en: An interactive tool for Squeekchain Genesis participants to select earned badges and estimate their Aura score. It applies specific caps for holder and community bonuses while noting that activity badge values vary by rarity. The planner suggests the next easiest badge to complete based on public data.
projects.name: Squeek Aura Planner

projects.description_en: A living 3D world built on Squeekchain, with a game at its centre. Visitors walk a hamster through an underground burrow where every pillar, block and door is backed by a real record, and The Great Dig turns real settled rounds into a game communities play together.
projects.name: Squeek Time Machine

projects.description_en: A planning tool for Squeekchain that calculates earnings from Squeeks and staked SQK under the Proof of Squeek rule. It helps users determine the optimal next move, such as merging Squeeks or adding more stake, by modeling network power and emission schedules.
projects.name: Squeek Power Planner

projects.description_en: Squeek Merge Desk is a utility for Squeekchain Genesis holders to review their Squeeks and compare merge options with SQK staking. It allows users to prepare unsigned transactions on Sepolia, ensuring the wallet signs the final action without the app ever accessing private keys.
projects.name: Squeek Merge Desk

projects.description_en: A non-custodial utility for Squeekchain on Ethereum Sepolia. Use it to discover your Squeek NFTs, inspect mining positions, and claim testnet SQK. It also allows you to safely preview merges before executing them.
projects.name: SqueekOptimizer

projects.description_en: A live dashboard that tracks the wheel speed, proof of work, and block production of Squeekchain. It displays real-time telemetry, settlements, and economic data updated every ten seconds. The interface visualizes how a single hamster powers a functioning blockchain.
projects.name: Squeekchain Live Dashboard

projects.description_en: Burrowkeep weaves confirmed Squeekchain Sepolia settlements into a pixel fabric and a musical score. You can view the woven pattern, listen to the generated melody, and download the result as PNG or MIDI files.
projects.name: Burrowkeep

projects.description_en: SPM is a free prediction game where you guess whether Squeektoshi will run over or under their seven-day average distance in the next 24 hours. Correct predictions earn points, with no tokens or fees involved.
projects.name: SPM · Squeek Prediction Market

projects.description_en: Wheelprints turns recorded Squeektoshi activity into original, deterministic SVG prints. You choose from three studies, each with a specific form and palette, to generate a unique composition based on on-chain data. The project includes a replay feature that shows how the drawing process unfolds over time.
projects.name: Wheelprints

projects.description_en: Squeek Escape is a pixel endless runner where the game speed is driven by a real hamster wheel on Squeekchain. You sprint during the day when the hamster is active and drift at night when it sleeps, creating a pace that changes with the animal's behavior.
projects.name: Squeek Escape

projects.description_en: An independent dashboard that tracks activity on the Squeekchain ecosystem. It also includes a hamster wheel game where players earn points for fun, which are not linked to SQK or blockchain transactions.
projects.name: Squeekchain Analytics

projects.description_en: Squeek Pulse is a non-custodial tool for managing Squeekchain assets on Sepolia. It displays your Squeeks and SQK stake, calculates network power, and allows you to stake, claim, deposit, withdraw, or merge items directly from your wallet.
projects.name: Squeek Pulse

projects.description_en: A read-only tool for checking a wallet's Squeeks and SQK balance on Squeekchain. Enter an address to see what the wallet holds on the hamster-powered proof-of-work testnet.
projects.name: Squeek Viewer

projects.description_en: A timed relay game where your racer moves only when a real hamster runs. Pick a racer, start a run, and pass the baton as accepted wheel passages from the Squeekchain public API carry your racer around the rim. It serves as a companion to SqueekRace Arena.
projects.name: SqueekRace Wheel Relay

paragraphs.text: Hamster Mining Reserve is a Sepolia vault that permanently pools Graph A Squeek mining NFTs, as described in
the project website
. Depositors receive ERC-20 accounting shares, while a strategist merges equal-level NFTs so holders can claim their proportion of funded SQK rewards.
To follow the source trail, start with
the documentation
for an overview of the mechanics. You can then explore
the code repository
to see how the single application contract operates, ensuring you understand the specific logic behind the pooling process.

projects.description_en: A Sepolia vault that permanently pools Graph A Squeek mining NFTs. Depositors receive hmSQUEEK accounting shares and can claim their proportion of funded SQK rewards. A strategist merges equal-level NFTs to manage the reserve's mining weight.
projects.name: Hamster Mining Reserve

projects.description_en: Squeek Sprouts is a pixel garden where crops grow based on the real-time wheel activity of Squeektoshi. You plant seeds, wait for the hamster to run, and harvest crops to earn crumbs and rare golden items. The garden pauses when the hamster naps, creating a slow-paced idle experience tied to live data.
projects.name: Squeek Sprouts

projects.description_en: SqueekYield is a staking application on Sepolia where users deposit SEED to earn a variable yield. The annual percentage yield starts at 5% and increases based on the wheel work settled by SqueekCore. Rewards are minted by the pool, ensuring that individual staking rates are not diluted by other participants.
projects.name: SqueekYield

projects.description_en: Squeek Flap is a browser game where you fly Squeektoshi through bamboo columns. The obstacle map is generated from the live Squeekchain round, ensuring every player faces the same layout. You can collect Aura orbs and use power-ups to survive longer.
projects.name: Squeek Flap

projects.description_en: Squeek Courier is a free browser game where you drive a hamster through a garden to collect sunflower seeds. You must dodge rocks and return to the central house within 60 seconds. The gameplay rhythm follows the real Squeekchain wheel.
projects.name: Squeek Courier

projects.description_en: An independent, read-only collection explorer for Squeekchain on Ethereum Sepolia. Enter an NFT ID to trace its merges, examine the artwork of each original and save a family card. The interface is available in English and simplified Chinese. Visitors never need a wallet.
projects.name: Squeek Family Album

projects.description_en: SqueekFi is a read-only dashboard that tracks certified hamster work from hardware readings through Ethereum settlement and mining checkpoints. It allows users to inspect public Squeek accounts, view claimable SQK, and monitor Genesis launch readiness without connecting a wallet.
projects.name: SqueekFi

projects.description_en: Listen to eight-second clips of Squeektoshi's wheel and decide if the passages are from the hamster or a fake source. A small trained model makes the same calls, highlighting the limits of sensor-based proof. The game reveals which specific details, like motor hums or hand movements, distinguish real runs from simulations.
projects.name: Real or Robot?

projects.description_en: SqueekBet is a prediction market where users stake SQK on whether Squeektoshi will mine enough blocks in upcoming rounds. Winners split the pool, and results are settled onchain without an oracle. A live camera stream allows participants to watch the hamster while betting.
projects.name: SqueekBet

projects.description_en: A free browser game where you predict whether a real hamster will exceed a baseline of wheel activity in the next minute. You earn points for accurate calls and compete against the Vacuum of the Void.
projects.name: Squeek Wheel Oracle

projects.description_en: Wheelworks is a puzzle game where you route energy pulses from a hamster wheel to workshop devices. You place conveyors, elbows, and alternators to deliver every device's pulse quota within a strict tick budget. The game features handcrafted boards and a challenge seeded by a Squeekchain settlement.
projects.name: Wheelworks

projects.description_en: Hamster Atlas is an interactive 3D viewer for exploring hamster specimens. Users can rotate and zoom the models to inspect them from any angle. The tool also supports searching by species, habitat, region or coat variety.
projects.name: Hamster Atlas

projects.description_en: Squeek Pouch is a puzzle game where you pack seeds, nuts, and tiny treasures into a hamster's cheek pouch. You complete twelve levels using energy from the live Squeekchain wheel. The game features a cozy theme and simple packing mechanics.
projects.name: Squeek Pouch

projects.description_en: An educational simulator that lets users spin a virtual hamster wheel to generate local, simulated scores. It demonstrates Proof-of-Hamster-Work mechanics without transferring cryptocurrency or interacting with the live blockchain.
projects.name: SqueekChain

projects.description_en: Squeek Forge visualizes Squeekchain's on-chain work as a real-time blacksmithing workshop. It displays cumulative hammer strikes, current ingot status, and 24-hour work metrics. The interface syncs with public chain data every ten seconds to show forging progress and settlement records.
projects.name: Squeek Forge

projects.description_en: Squeek Pouch is a hamster arcade game where you catch seeds and dodge pebbles to fill your pouch. The real hamster Squeektoshi's wheel boosts your deposits, and every Squeek block triggers a golden storm. Bank your seeds at the burrow to score points.
projects.name: Squeek Pouch

projects.description_en: A parody investigation site that presents a case file on Squeektoshi, the hamster powering SqueekChain. It displays evidence cards covering the hamster's biography, the wheel apparatus, movement logs, and token distribution. Users follow the red string to inspect the sources and check the live alibi.
projects.name: Who is Squeektoshi?

projects.description_en: A 3D endless runner where players control one of five hamsters with unique skills to dodge obstacles and collect sunflower seeds. Daily tracks are generated from Squeekchain data, and daily champions are recorded on-chain via ScoreLedger.
projects.name: Hamster Run

projects.description_en: A live dashboard that displays data from the Squeekchain API. It provides a real-time view of the hamster-powered toychain's activity. The project serves as a community tool for monitoring the network.
projects.name: Squeekchain Dashboard

projects.description_en: Wheel Canvas is a community artwork where Squeektoshi's wheel movements paint a live generative canvas. You can add your own colored stroke by signing a zero-value SQK approval on Sepolia, contributing to the evolving piece.
projects.name: Wheel Canvas

projects.description_en: Squeekstr is a protocol that merges SQUEEK NFTs to increase their mining power. Users deposit their NFTs to receive tracker receipts, which serve as claims on the rewards generated by the shared pool. The system also uses tax revenue from its native token to acquire additional SQUEEKs for the vault.
projects.name: sqkstr

projects.description_en: WheelTrace - live, read-only Squeekchain telemetry dashboard. Canvas hamster wheel driven by real rpmMilli, RPM trace, block progress, SQK supply.
projects.name: wheeltrace

projects.description_en: Fantasy Hamster is a daily game where you draft five predictions about Squeektoshi's next UTC day and pick a Captain. The real hamster on the wheel determines your final score. It is a free, fan-made project designed for fun.
projects.name: Fantasy Hamster

projects.description_en: SQUEELODY turns live Squeekchain hamster-wheel telemetry into generated music using Web Audio in your browser. The wheel's speed sets the tempo, while distance and work units seed the melody for each round. You can listen to the live mixtape and download a unique SVG vinyl record for every round.
projects.name: SQUEELODY

projects.description_en: SqueekRider Odyssey is a free action runner where you fly a royal wheel-bike through desert trails. You collect Cheese Coins, upgrade your bike, and battle Baron Von Claw. The game's HUD displays live telemetry from Squeektoshi's wheel on Squeekchain.
projects.name: SqueekRider Odyssey

projects.description_en: Squeek Predict is an on-chain prediction market where you bet Sepolia test ETH on the Squeekchain hamster's performance. You take a side on whether the hamster will complete a specific number of blocks within a 24-hour or 7-day window. The platform displays clear pool odds and tracks your positions in one place.
projects.name: Squeek Predict

projects.description_en: Squeek Garden is a virtual hamster garden where users plant seeds and watch them grow. The garden's progress is driven by settled Squeekchain rounds on Sepolia. Users can collect their harvest as the plants mature.
projects.name: Squeek Garden

projects.description_en: SQUEEK ARENA is a prediction game where three hamsters race every five minutes. You place SQK on your chosen hamster to win the race, with payouts handled by a contract that has no admin.
projects.name: SQUEEK ARENA

projects.description_en: Squeek Wheel Rush is a free browser game where you control Squeektoshi running inside a wheel. You jump over pegs and collect seeds to earn points, with a live bonus when the real hamster is active. Scores are tracked on a worldwide leaderboard.
projects.name: Squeek Wheel Rush

projects.description_en: A read-only dashboard that tracks Squeekchain activity on the Sepolia testnet. It displays the current mining round, total SQK mined, live Squeek NFTs, and public contract addresses. The interface offers a simple view of the hamster-powered economy without requiring interaction.
projects.name: Squeekchain dashboard

projects.description_en: Squeek Alerts is a read-only service that monitors Squeekchain activity and sends notifications when the hamster starts running, falls asleep, or a checkpoint is ready. Users can receive these updates via Telegram, GitHub, RSS, or a custom bot without needing to keep a browser tab open.
projects.name: Squeek Alerts

projects.description_en: Burrow Power is a neon survival game where you protect Pip's underground home through six illustrated encounters. Real Squeekchain wheel activity shapes the gameplay, requiring you to choose between spending power on protection, improvising, or accepting damage to bank resources.
projects.name: Burrow Power

projects.description_en: Crypto Hamster Run is an endless runner game where players control a hamster to jump, slide and shoot obstacles. Passing obstacles mines blocks, with near misses and combos providing bonuses. A boss appears every 500 blocks, requiring weapons to defeat.
projects.name: Crypto Hamster Run

projects.description_en: Wheel Merge is an arcade game where you drop hamsters into a turning wheel and merge matching neighbours to beat the timer. The game's speed follows the live Squeekchain hamster wheel, and completed blocks grant a joker token.
projects.name: Wheel Merge

projects.description_en: Users can generate names in various styles, collect likes, and receive SQK tips. The site displays real-time hamster activity and weekly leaderboards.
projects.name: Squeek 起名屋

projects.description_en: SqueekScope is a command center for the Squeekchain testnet that displays live network metrics. It tracks block height, difficulty, active power, and SQK token issuance. Users can monitor round progress and verify ledger integrity through real-time data snapshots.
projects.name: SqueekScope

projects.description_en: SqueekVision is a live dashboard for the SqueekChain network on Sepolia. It displays Squeektoshi's wheel status, block progress, $SQK supply, and settlement data, refreshing every 15 seconds.
projects.name: SqueekVision

projects.description_en: Squeek Clicker is a 60-second pixel mouse clicker game for the Squeekchain community. Players click a mouse to build a 5x combo and chase their personal best score.
projects.name: Squeek Clicker

projects.description_en: A browser-based tool for building custom OBS overlays for Squeekchain streams. You can arrange widgets to display live wheel telemetry, settled blocks, and recent events. The editor runs entirely in the browser without requiring a wallet or account.
projects.name: Squeek Studio

projects.description_en: Ghost Wheel lets you race against a replay of Squeektoshi's real recorded wheel runs. You spin an on-screen wheel using your mouse, trackpad, finger, or arrow keys. The game counts your passages using the WHEELY9000's specific rules and displays his actual Squeek blocks at the corresponding moments.
projects.name: Ghost Wheel

projects.description_en: Mint a free on-chain pixel hamster on Sepolia. Its art changes to show running, napping, or sleeping based on Squeekchain's wheel activity.
projects.name: Squeek Companion

projects.description_en: Squeek & Glide is a 2D flying game where a real Squeekchain hamster powers the wind. You tap to fly, dodge cardboard obstacles, and collect Golden Seeds for double points.
projects.name: Squeek & Glide

projects.description_en: A retro top-down open-world heist game where you play a hamster thief moving through a small town. The game's day and night cycle is driven live by Squeektoshi, the real hamster mining Squeekchain blocks.
projects.name: Squeek City

projects.description_en: Squeek Runner is a game where speed and score are controlled by Squeektoshi's real wheel activity. Players tap or press space to jump, and the final score can be recorded on Sepolia via a transaction.
projects.name: Squeek Runner

projects.description_en: The Wheelpaper turns the Squeekchain whitepaper into an interactive site where you can drag handles to test difficulty adjustments and supply schedules. It reads live Sepolia state to show how the pixel wheel spins at Squeektoshi's real RPM and stops when he sleeps.
projects.name: The Wheelpaper

projects.description_en: Every turn of Squeektoshi's wheel paints a dot. Live site: https://mstrsqueek.xyz · Source: https://github.com/15665322008/wheel-canvas
projects.name: Wheel Canvas / 仓鼠画布

projects.description_en: Hamster Nap is a community game where players buy NAP tokens to become the last buyer before Squeektoshi naps. A 2% fee from each purchase builds a pot of test ETH, which the final buyer wins when the hamster's nap is certified. The game runs as a Uniswap v4 hook on the Sepolia testnet.
projects.name: Hamster Nap (NAP)

projects.description_en: A companion dashboard for Squeekchain that streams live footage of Squeektoshi and displays real-time metrics like wheel RPM and block height. Users can send a zero-allowance test transaction to verify their wallet and earn a Genesis badge.
projects.name: Squeek Pit Crew

projects.description_en: NutshellMarkets is a treasury project built to support the growth of Squeekchain. It functions as a financial reserve intended to sustain and expand the ecosystem.
projects.name: NutshellMarkets

projects.description_en: Among Squeeks is a social deduction game where players mine blocks and identify a secret Rugger. The gameplay is driven by Squeektoshi, a real hamster whose wheel activity powers the chain. You can play against AI hamsters or invite friends to join the crew.
projects.name: Among Squeeks

projects.description_en: Smart contracts for Squeeky Market, an independent prediction market on Squeektoshi’s daily wheel distance. Users trade play money on how far the hamster runs between UTC noon markers. The system polls live distance data every five seconds to resolve bets.
projects.name: Squeeky Market

projects.description_en: Squeek Arena is a web-based platform that displays real-time telemetry from a physical hamster wheel, including speed and power output. Users can interact with the system by sending on-chain transactions to boost the wheel's speed or place wagers in a sprint betting game. The project also features a dynamic NFT that evolves based on the hamster's cumulative revolutions.
projects.name: SQUEEK ARENA

projects.description_en: Squeek Stream Kit is an OBS overlay and control panel for the Squeekchain hamster wheel. It displays live SPINNING and IDLE alerts, RPM, block progress, and round countdowns. The tool also supports viewer cheers to engage your audience.
projects.name: Squeek Stream Kit

projects.description_en: Squeek Life is a pixel art life simulation where you play as a rat moving from poverty to wealth. You scavenge trash, take jobs, and upgrade your appearance to unlock the rich district. The game uses live Squeekchain data and in-game coins to track your progress.
projects.name: Squeek Life: From Rags to Riches

projects.description_en: Wheel Call lets you predict how hard the Squeekchain hamster will run in the next 10-minute round. You choose a speed band and compete against an Oracle that makes its own call with the same stake. Correct predictions earn seeds based on fixed odds, with results settled on-chain.
projects.name: Wheel Call

projects.description_en: Squeek’s First Road Trip is a community game where you watch the settled wheel distance and explore 64 destinations. You vote for the next stop on Sepolia to guide Squeek’s journey. The project turns a small hamster wheel into a way to choose a big world of travel.
projects.name: Squeek’s First Road Trip

projects.description_en: Squeek Runner is a free 2D endless runner where you control a mouse jumping over pantry obstacles to collect cheese. The game supports keyboard and touch controls, allowing players to beat their local best score during short breaks.
projects.name: Squeek Runner

same_wallet.name: Squeek Radar: Live Activity and Event Monitor

projects.description_en: Myth Arena is a turn-based PvP strategy game where players guess the order of eggs in their opponent's rack. The game uses zero-knowledge proofs to verify guesses and prevent tampering. Players compete to be the first to correctly identify the opponent's arrangement.
projects.name: Myth Arena

projects.description_en: Squeek Tales is a community-written story game where a hamster's adventures are determined by Squeekchain rounds. You choose the next chapter based on the work performed in the previous round, with different activity levels leading to different narrative outcomes. The project runs on Sepolia and offers daily test ETH rewards for participation.
projects.name: Squeek Tales

projects.description_en: A weekly boss-raid browser game for the Squeekchain Genesis Code lane.
projects.name: Squeekchain Boss Raid

projects.description_en: Squeek Relay is a live arcade race where a real hamster powers the track. Players grab batons and build combos while riding Squeektoshi's energy. The hamster's activity changes the track, with running providing speed and sleep turning it to ice.
projects.name: Squeek Relay

projects.description_en: A free 45-second arcade game where you control a hamster to collect seeds and batteries while avoiding rocks. It supports both mobile and keyboard controls with a language toggle for English and Chinese.
projects.name: Hamster Dash

projects.description_en: Burrow is a financial district on Squeekchain where users borrow SQK against Squeek NFTs. The collateral continues mining on the chain, and the generated rewards automatically repay the loan debt.
projects.name: Burrow

projects.description_en: Squeek Play is a Squeekchain companion that lets you race Squeektoshi in a four-lane derby and follow live WHEELY9000 telemetry. It also includes tools to explore SqueekFi power and NFT merges, offering a playful way to interact with the hamster-powered ecosystem.
projects.name: Squeek Play

projects.description_en: SqueekPad is a launchpad on Squeekchain where token phases unlock based on settled Squeek blocks. Users can buy tokens from the first second, with Squeek holders receiving extra access during the initial hour. The platform features a fixed bonding curve, 0% tax, and burned liquidity.
projects.name: SqueekPad

projects.description_en: Tap a tempo to trace the real speed curves of Squeektoshi's hamster-wheel runs. An unofficial Squeekchain fan game.
projects.name: Hamster Pacer: Echo

projects.description_en: Squeektoshi’s Diary tracks the daily activity of the hamster powering Squeekchain. It displays live wheel speed, distance, and historical pass counts to show how the animal contributes to the proof-of-work process on the Sepolia testnet.
projects.name: Squeektoshi’s Diary

projects.description_en: HamsterRun v3 is a free-to-mint on-chain game where players mint, feed, and train a hamster. The project features certified wheel training and racing mechanics without reward promises.
projects.name: HamsterRun

projects.description_en: A one-button pixel arcade where you control Squeektoshi to collect seeds and dodge spikes. The game mirrors the live Squeekchain wheel, letting you see how many blocks you can mine in a session.
projects.name: Wheel Rush

projects.description_en: Six factions fight over one map. Every move is powered by @squeektoshi, a real hamster on a real wheel. Free to play. Built on @squeekchain.
projects.name: Squeek Turf

projects.description_en: The live pulse of Squeekchain. Follow the hamster's wheel, block progress, distance run, and the community moving the chain forward.
projects.name: Squeek Pulse

projects.description_en: A stream companion HUD that tracks live Sepolia blocks, SqueekCore round state, and active hamster wheel mining progress on Squeekchain.
projects.name: Squeekside

projects.description_en: Squeek Dome is a non-custodial workbench for managing Squeeks on the Sepolia testnet. Users can inspect live holders, crank checkpoints, batch-claim SQK, and merge Squeeks using real wallet transactions.
projects.name: Squeek Dome

projects.description_en: Catch the Cheese is a one-button arcade game where you catch falling cheese wedges in a 60-second round. The game is powered by Squeektoshi's live wheel, which determines the speed and type of cheese drops. Catching cheese fills a snack meter, while misses break your streak.
projects.name: Catch the Cheese

projects.description_en: SQUEEKFOREST: SEEDKEEPER is a free community game where you plant, shade, and illuminate a pixel forest. The puzzles are rooted in settled Squeekchain blocks, offering a moonlit positioning challenge. You can practice offline to keep the grove alive.
projects.name: SQUEEKFOREST: SEEDKEEPER

projects.description_en: Squeek Garden is a pixel garden where plants grow based on Squeektoshi's real wheel rounds. You plant seeds, manage barn animals, and collect goods to earn pips. The game includes skills, decorations, and daily challenges to track your progress.
projects.name: Squeek Garden

projects.description_en: Wheelhold is a persistent colony strategy game where Squeektoshi's verified wheel activity determines round outcomes. Players manage a personal colony whose fate is written by the hamster's real activity on the wheel.
projects.name: Wheelhold

projects.description_en: Squeek Analytics provides read-only charts for the Squeek Chain public work record. It tracks work history, block milestones, settlement lag, and hamster performance on Ethereum Sepolia.
projects.name: Squeek Analytics

projects.description_en: Squeek Colony is a free cooperative pixel game where players build a shared hamster burrow. Each ten-minute Squeekchain round, you choose to Forage, Fortify, or Research, with the official wheel result settling your progress. The game reads public chain data to drive its mechanics.
projects.name: Squeek Colony
